visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with brown hair tied back, wearing glasses and a black graphic t-shirt, sits upright at a brown wooden piano. Her fingers move rhythmically across the black and white keys as she looks intently at sheet music propped up before her. The room is dimly lit with warm light reflecting off the glossy piano surface and beige curtains in the background. (2) Her composure breaks into a wide smile and then boisterous laughter as she continues to play. Her head tilts slightly as she looks off-camera towards an unseen individual, while her hands continue their motion but with less precision. (3) She eventually stops playing completely, leaning back and laughing heartily. She reaches out with her right hand to adjust or pick up some loose white papers resting on the piano's edge, still smiling and conversing with someone out of frame.
